This market refers to the tennis match between Shiho Tsujioka and Kamilla Rakhimova in the Pan Pacific Open, Qualification, originally scheduled for October 23, 2026 at 9:30PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Shiho Tsujioka" if Shiho Tsujioka wins by 2 or more sets than Kamilla Rakhimova, based on the final completed score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Kamilla Rakhimova."
If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play under the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round. For example, if the deciding set has begun when the match ends, Shiho Tsujioka can no longer win by 2 or more sets, and this market will resolve to "Kamilla Rakhimova."
If the match is canceled before play begins, or a result has not been determined by November 6, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official WTA results.
